title: feat(nm2splt3slx): 1-in 2-out freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis same-lock x-probes: reverse fails, face fails, composition HOLD
science: same-lock x-probes, bare split compared at t+1 vs t+2. Its own note observes M and O 'stay equal' from t+1 to t+2 and files that as a coincidental leftover; it is in fact forced. Composition is forced: O(q,tau) is constant for all tau>=t(q)+1 (any step e in O(q) requires e in M(q+e), which forces t(q+e)=t(q)+1), so t+2 can never differ from t+1 and composition=HOLD carries zero information.
